description: Per-column adaptive string codec. Structured bit-packed schemes for c_name/genome/hex/uuid/location; row-dictionary for long-row duplicate-heavy text; FSST symbol coding with zstd-12 code streams for general text. Full decode: single-pass FSST expansion. Selected rows: per-row FSST decode over a lazily built offset index; no full-column decode, no cross-row state, no output caching.
name: dbtext-fsst-hybrid
